record.title: 35 x 25 x 7 mm head speaker — representative '3525' 8 Ω 2 W box speaker (exact fitted part CANNOT DETERMINE)
record.manufacturer: CANNOT DETERMINE for the fitted part. The representative '3525' is an anonymous commodity part; ABRA's listing names no maker; thingbits' listing names a model 'XHXDZ-3525-8R2W'.

sources.name: abra
sources.what: ABRA Electronics reseller page 'SPK-3525-2W-GH 3525 8R 2W Box Speaker with GH1.25 Terminal Wire', USD$ 2.95, whose description reproduces a maker's spec table (impedance test conditions, SPL method, terminal strength and solder tests). HTTP 200, text/html, 759823 bytes. THE PRIMARY SOURCE for the representative's figures; a reseller, not a manufacturer.

sources.name: thingbits
sources.what: thingbits.net reseller page for a '3525 waterproof 8 ohm 2W cavity speaker', model XHXDZ-3525-8R2W, 35 x 25 x 6.2 mm. A SECOND 3525 whose figures DISAGREE with ABRA's (impedance printed '9Ω ±15%', F0 '~20KHz'); recorded as the named disagreement it is, not averaged.

sources.name: samesky
sources.what: Same Sky (formerly CUI Devices) CMS-35208N datasheet, 4 pages, dated 01/22/2020 — the nearest rectangular micro speaker WITH a manufacturer datasheet. Watermarked DISCONTINUED (the URL redirected to /product/discontinued/). 35.5 x 20.5 x 8.0 mm read off the rendered p.1 (the text layer scrambles the table columns): the wrong width for Pollen's 25 mm box. A contrast, not the representative.

record.datasheet_rev: ABRA product page as fetched 2026-09-02; no revision or date on the page. Page heading verbatim: 'SPK-3525-2W-GH 3525 8R 2W Box Speaker with GH1.25 Terminal Wire Price: USD$ 2.95'.
record.datasheet_rev_quote: SPK-3525-2W-GH 3525 8R 2W Box Speaker with GH1.25 Terminal Wire Price: USD$ 2.95
record.package: Rectangular enclosed ('box'/'cavity') speaker, 'Size: 35mm x 25mm x 6.8mm.' (ABRA) with a 2-wire lead and a 1.25 mm-pitch 2-pin connector ('GH1.25' per ABRA's title; thingbits: '1.25-2P (2-pin, 1.25mm pitch)'). Pollen's placeholder: 35.0 x 25.0 x 7.0 mm.

pinout.polarity_quote: Polarity: The diaphragm moves forward when a positive DC voltage is applied to the "+" terminal (red).
pinout.cite: docs/abra-spk-3525-2w-gh.html description, verbatim. Two terminals; the red lead is +.
pinout.verdict: PASS for the representative; CANNOT DETERMINE for the fitted part

requires.name: SPK+
requires.why: one terminal of an 8 Ω voice coil; needs a speaker-level drive (a Class-D or the codec's own output). WHAT DRIVES IT IN THE MICRODUCK IS CANNOT DETERMINE: the TLV320AIC3104 codec has line and headphone outputs; whether a separate amplifier sits on the HAT is unpublished (docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md §7).

record.supplies_why: a passive transducer; no supply pin.

disagreement.quote: Model XHXDZ-3525-8R2W Dimensions 35 × 25 × 6.2 mm Rated Impedance 9Ω ±15% Rated Power 2W
disagreement.cite: docs/thingbits-xhxdz-3525-8r2w.html specification table — prints '9Ω' for a model whose name says '8R'. Recorded, not adopted; ABRA's 8 Ω with a stated test condition wins.

resonance_Hz.cite: docs/abra-spk-3525-2w-gh.html. thingbits prints 'Resonant Frequency (F0) ~20KHz' for its 3525 — physically implausible for a 35 mm cone and recorded only as the disagreement it is.

spl_dB.quote: SPL (Sound Pressure Level): 88 dB ± 3dB at 2.0W/0.1m, measured at 800Hz, 1000Hz, 1200Hz, and 1500Hz average.
spl_dB.cite: docs/abra-spk-3525-2w-gh.html — note the 0.1 m distance and 2.0 W drive; not comparable to a 1 W / 1 m figure without conversion.

record.frequency_response_quote: Response Frequency Range: From Fo to 20 kHz with a deviation of -10 dB max.
record.distortion_quote: Distortion: Less than 5% at 1 kHz with 2.0W power input.

contrast_part_samesky.cite: docs/samesky-cms-35208n-datasheet.pdf p.1 (Same Sky, 01/22/2020, DISCONTINUED watermark): specifications table rows read off a 110 dpi render — input power 1.0 W typ / 1.5 W max, impedance 6.8 / 8 / 9.2 Ω at 1.0 kHz 1.0 V, resonant frequency 576 / 720 / 864 Hz, SPL 95 / 98 / 101 dB at 1.0 W 0.1 m, dimensions 35.5 x 20.5 x 8.0 mm, weight 5.9 g. Only the two quoted strings survive the PDF's text layer intact; the rest are stated as read off the render. NOT the representative: 20.5 mm wide against Pollen's 25 mm.

unknowns: THE FITTED SPEAKER: part number, maker, impedance, power, connector — CANNOT DETERMINE (docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md §7, §12 item 11). A teardown of the head settles it.
WHAT DRIVES IT: the TLV320AIC3104's own output vs an external amplifier — CANNOT DETERMINE (HAT unpublished).

THE REPRESENTATIVE HAS NO MANUFACTURER DATASHEET: its figures are a reseller's transcription of an anonymous maker's table (ABRA). A second reseller (thingbits) disagrees on impedance (9 Ω) and F0 (~20 kHz). No figure here has been measured.
Height: ABRA 6.8 mm, thingbits 6.2 mm, Pollen's box 7.0 mm — three numbers, none measured here.
No sourced offer is recorded (sourcing.json not written); ABRA's USD$ 2.95 is quoted only as the page's own text.
